content: Latent Dirichlet allocation (LDA) is used in BIBREF2 to extract mixture of latent topics. However, it focusses on finding the latent topics of a document, not the word meanings themselves. In BIBREF3, LSA is utilised to generate word vectors, leveraging indirect co-occurrence statistics. These outperform the use of sparse vectors BIBREF4.
